title: Tire Rotation Estimate Worksheet
subtitle: Tire Rotation Service: prices observed scope, options, and exclusions.
description: Tire Rotation Estimate Worksheet covers vehicle, tire position, size, condition, pressure, wheel, fastener, and rotation pattern. The tire service advisor records Tire Rotation Service observed scope, costs, options, and terms. Tire Rotation Estimate Worksheet keeps Tire Rotation Service exceptions visible until the tire service advisor handoff.
use_case: Use Tire Rotation Estimate Worksheet at service bay, lift, wheel positions, inflation point, and customer handoff. Document vehicle, tire position, size, condition, pressure, wheel, fastener, and rotation pattern identity before Tire Rotation Service begins. Compare vehicle, tire position, size, condition, pressure, wheel, fastener, and rotation pattern findings with stated Tire Rotation Service criteria; route unresolved Tire Rotation Service issues to qualified tire service reviewer. For Tire Rotation Estimate Worksheet, confirm requirements for Tire Rotation Service. Ask qualified tire service reviewer to review Tire Rotation Service conditions beyond the tire service advisor's role.

sections.title: Pricing evidence and service location
sections.guidance: For Tire Rotation Service, identify responsible parties, service bay, lift, wheel positions, inflation point, and customer handoff, and the linked vehicle, tire position, size, condition, pressure, wheel, fastener, and rotation pattern source.

fields.label: Tire brand, size, position, DOT or unit identity when needed

sections.title: Estimate lines and customer options
sections.guidance: Capture Tire Rotation Service facts for vehicle, tire position, size, condition, pressure, wheel, fastener, and rotation pattern; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Tire Rotation Service estimate checks
items: Tread depth and wear pattern by position
Sidewall, bead, puncture, and visible damage
Wheel, hub, stud, nut, and mounting surface
Rotation pattern and directional or staggered restriction
Fastener tightening evidence and warning-system reset

sections.title: Estimate review, options, and acknowledgment
sections.guidance: Resolve open Tire Rotation Service conditions; have tire service advisor assign the next Tire Rotation Service owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Pricing assumptions, exclusions, and retained evidence
items: Size or pattern prevents planned rotation
Stud, nut, wheel, or hub damage
Specified fastening or pressure verification incomplete
blocks.guidance: Pause Tire Rotation Service when tire roadworthiness, fitment, wheel attachment, inflation, or required verification remains unresolved. Retain the available Tire Rotation Service proof and route unresolved vehicle, tire position, size, condition, pressure, wheel, fastener, and rotation pattern scope to tire service advisor.
